# MORNING BRIEF — BITCOIN INTELLIGENCE

**The macro picture just shifted.** Fed rate-tightening has hit a wall. That removes a major headwind Bitcoin faced. Protocol strength amplifies precisely when external controls tighten—and regulators are now testing seizure boundaries hard. The implication: censorship resistance becomes the narrative, not speculation.

**On-chain signals confirm conviction.** Hashrate holding firm at 1007 EH/s. Network security sustained despite market fear gauge at 29. M
